scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.shop: concurrently -n api-oos,web-shop,web-oos -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run shop:api-oos" "npm run shop:web" "npm run shop:oos"
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api-crms && dotnet ef database update
scripts.db:migration:add: cd apps/api-crms && dotnet ef migrations add
scripts.db:migration:remove: cd apps/api-crms && dotnet ef migrations remove
scripts.db:migration:list: cd apps/api-crms && dotnet ef migrations list
